title: OEDS Open Power System Data
description: Open Power System Data: when2heat heat demand and heat pump COP profiles (hourly, 28 countries) and national generation capacities.

list.name: country
list.label: Country
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT left(column_name,2) AS __value FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='opsd' AND table_name='when2heat' AND column_name ~ '^[A-Z]{2}_COP_ASHP_floor$' ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT left(column_name,2) AS __value FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='opsd' AND table_name='when2heat' AND column_name ~ '^[A-Z]{2}_COP_ASHP_floor$' ORDER BY 1
list.description: Country code (ISO 3166 alpha-2, GB for the UK).

list.name: source
list.label: Capacity source
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT source FROM opsd.national_generation_capacity ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT source FROM opsd.national_generation_capacity ORDER BY 1
list.description: Source of the national generation capacities. EUROSTAT is the only one that covers 1990-2016 for 40 countries.

panels.title: opsd.when2heat
panels.description: First and latest timestamp and approximate rows of the hourly when2heat table (28 countries x demand, COP and profile columns). Heat demand (MW) is only available until 2015-12-31 (NULL afterwards); COPs and profiles reach 2022-12-31.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (extract(epoch from min(utc_timestamp))*1000)::bigint as "First", (extract(epoch from max(utc_timestamp))*1000)::bigint as "Latest", approximate_row_count('opsd.when2heat'::regclass) as "Rows (approx.)"
FROM opsd.when2heat

panels.title: opsd.national_generation_capacity
panels.description: Countries, years and rows of the stacked national generation capacity table (annual MW, several sources).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT country) AS "Countries", min(year) AS "First year", max(year) AS "Last year", count(*) AS "Rows", count(DISTINCT source) AS "Sources" FROM opsd.national_generation_capacity

panels.title: $country in the selected range
panels.description: Heat energy (hourly MW summed), peak demand and mean heat pump COPs (ASHP: air-source, GSHP: ground-source; radiator heating 35-55 degC flow temperature, floor heating 30-35 degC).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum("${country}_heat_demand_total")/1e6 AS "Heat demand", max("${country}_heat_demand_total")/1000 AS "Peak demand", avg("${country}_COP_ASHP_radiator") AS "COP ASHP radiator", avg("${country}_COP_GSHP_radiator") AS "COP GSHP radiator", avg("${country}_COP_ASHP_water") AS "COP ASHP hot water"
FROM opsd.when2heat WHERE $__timeFilter(utc_timestamp)

panels.title: Heat demand: space heating and hot water
panels.description: Hourly heat demand of all buildings in the country for space heating and domestic hot water (MW, stacked). Weather driven (temperature, wind, irradiation): space heating peaks in cold spells and nearly vanishes in summer; hot water is almost constant. Heat demand (MW) is only available until 2015-12-31 (NULL afterwards); COPs and profiles reach 2022-12-31.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(utc_timestamp,$__interval), avg("${country}_heat_demand_space") AS "Space heating", avg("${country}_heat_demand_water") AS "Hot water"
FROM opsd.when2heat WHERE $__timeFilter(utc_timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Heat demand duration curve
panels.description: Hourly total heat demand sorted from highest to lowest (GW). x is the share of hours in which the demand is exceeded: the peak hours define the required heat generation capacity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (1-i/50.0)*100 AS "Share of hours exceeded (%)", percentile_cont(i/50.0) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "${country}_heat_demand_total") / 1000 AS "Heat demand"
FROM opsd.when2heat, generate_series(0,50) i WHERE $__timeFilter(utc_timestamp) GROUP BY i ORDER BY i DESC

panels.title: Heat demand by building type
panels.description: Space heating plus hot water demand split into single-family houses (SFH), multi-family houses (MFH) and commercial buildings (COM), daily mean (MW).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(utc_timestamp,'1d'), avg("${country}_heat_demand_space_SFH") + avg("${country}_heat_demand_water_SFH") AS "Single-family houses", avg("${country}_heat_demand_space_MFH") + avg("${country}_heat_demand_water_MFH") AS "Multi-family houses", avg("${country}_heat_demand_space_COM") + avg("${country}_heat_demand_water_COM") AS "Commercial"
FROM opsd.when2heat WHERE $__timeFilter(utc_timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monthly heat demand
panels.description: Heat energy per calendar month (TWh) in the selected range, space heating and hot water stacked. The strong winter/summer ratio is what makes heat pump electricity demand seasonal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month', utc_timestamp), 'YYYY-MM') AS "Month", sum("${country}_heat_demand_space")/1e6 AS "Space heating", sum("${country}_heat_demand_water")/1e6 AS "Hot water"
FROM opsd.when2heat WHERE $__timeFilter(utc_timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily profile of the heat demand (local time)
panels.description: Mean total heat demand (MW) by hour of the day (Europe/Berlin) for the heating season (Nov-Mar) and summer (Jun-Aug) within the range. The morning and evening peaks are the occupancy pattern of the reference profiles.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(hour from utc_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::int AS "Hour", avg("${country}_heat_demand_total") FILTER (WHERE extract(month from utc_timestamp) IN (11,12,1,2,3)) AS "Heating season (Nov-Mar)", avg("${country}_heat_demand_total") FILTER (WHERE extract(month from utc_timestamp) IN (6,7,8)) AS "Summer (Jun-Aug)"
FROM opsd.when2heat WHERE $__timeFilter(utc_timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Reference heat profiles by hour of the day
panels.description: Normalised when2heat reference profiles (dimensionless weights, local hour Europe/Berlin) for space heating and hot water of SFH, MFH and commercial buildings, mean over the range. Profiles are the input that is scaled to the national demand.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(hour from utc_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::int AS "Hour", avg("${country}_heat_profile_space_SFH") AS "space SFH", avg("${country}_heat_profile_space_MFH") AS "space MFH", avg("${country}_heat_profile_space_COM") AS "space COM", avg("${country}_heat_profile_water_SFH") AS "water SFH", avg("${country}_heat_profile_water_MFH") AS "water MFH", avg("${country}_heat_profile_water_COM") AS "water COM"
FROM opsd.when2heat WHERE $__timeFilter(utc_timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Heat demand by country (selected range)
panels.description: Total heat demand (TWh) of all 28 countries summed over the selected range. Choose a range within 2008-2015.

targets.rawSql: SELECT left(key,2) AS "Country", sum(value::float)/1e6 AS "Heat demand (TWh)" FROM opsd.when2heat t, jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(t)) WHERE $__timeFilter(utc_timestamp) AND key ~ '^[A-Z]{2}_heat_demand_total$' AND value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Coefficient of performance (daily mean)
panels.description: COP of air-source (ASHP), ground-source (GSHP) and water-source (WSHP) heat pumps depends on the source and flow temperature. Radiator: ~35-55 degC, floor ~30-35 degC, water: hot-water preparation (~50-60 degC). ASHP COPs fall in cold spells, GSHP/WSHP stay more stable.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(utc_timestamp,'1d'), avg("${country}_COP_ASHP_floor") AS "ASHP floor", avg("${country}_COP_ASHP_radiator") AS "ASHP radiator", avg("${country}_COP_ASHP_water") AS "ASHP water", avg("${country}_COP_GSHP_floor") AS "GSHP floor", avg("${country}_COP_GSHP_radiator") AS "GSHP radiator", avg("${country}_COP_GSHP_water") AS "GSHP water", avg("${country}_COP_WSHP_floor") AS "WSHP floor", avg("${country}_COP_WSHP_radiator") AS "WSHP radiator", avg("${country}_COP_WSHP_water") AS "WSHP water"
FROM opsd.when2heat WHERE $__timeFilter(utc_timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: COP by country (ASHP radiator, selected range)
panels.description: Mean COP of air-source heat pumps with radiator heating per country: warmer countries have higher COP.

targets.rawSql: SELECT left(key,2) AS "Country", avg(value::float) AS "COP ASHP radiator" FROM opsd.when2heat t, jsonb_each_text(to_jsonb(t)) WHERE $__timeFilter(utc_timestamp) AND key ~ '^[A-Z]{2}_COP_ASHP_radiator$' AND value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Seasonal COP (mean per month)
panels.description: Mean COP per calendar month over the selected range for the main heat pump types. Air-source COPs are lowest in winter exactly when the heat demand is highest.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT lpad(extract(month from utc_timestamp)::int::text, 2, '0') AS "Month", avg("${country}_COP_ASHP_radiator") AS "ASHP radiator", avg("${country}_COP_ASHP_floor") AS "ASHP floor", avg("${country}_COP_ASHP_water") AS "ASHP water", avg("${country}_COP_GSHP_radiator") AS "GSHP radiator", avg("${country}_COP_GSHP_floor") AS "GSHP floor"
FROM opsd.when2heat WHERE $__timeFilter(utc_timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: COP over the day
panels.description: Mean COP by hour of the day (UTC) for the range: air-source heat pumps perform best in the warm afternoon hours.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT extract(hour from utc_timestamp)::int AS "Hour (UTC)", avg("${country}_COP_ASHP_radiator") AS "ASHP radiator", avg("${country}_COP_ASHP_floor") AS "ASHP floor", avg("${country}_COP_GSHP_radiator") AS "GSHP radiator"
FROM opsd.when2heat WHERE $__timeFilter(utc_timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Installed capacity by technology
panels.description: Installed generation capacity (MW) per year by main technology group of the selected source; the source defines what is counted. Independent of the time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT year::text AS "Year", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Nuclear') AS "Nuclear", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Fossil fuels') AS "Fossil fuels", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Hydro') AS "Hydro", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Wind') AS "Wind", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Solar') AS "Solar", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Bioenergy and renewable waste') AS "Bioenergy and renewable waste"
FROM opsd.national_generation_capacity WHERE country = '${country}' AND source = '${source}' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

panels.title: Wind and solar capacity by source
panels.description: Installed wind and solar capacity (MW) for the selected country as reported by all available sources, to show how much they disagree.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT year AS "Year", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Wind' AND source = 'EUROSTAT') AS "Wind - EUROSTAT", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Wind' AND source = 'ENTSO-E SOAF') AS "Wind - ENTSO-E SOAF", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Wind' AND source = 'ENTSO-E Data Portal') AS "Wind - ENTSO-E Data Portal", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Wind' AND source = 'ENTSO-E Power Statistics') AS "Wind - ENTSO-E Power Statistics", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Wind' AND source = 'ENTSO-E Transparency Platform') AS "Wind - ENTSO-E Transparency Platform", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Solar' AND source = 'EUROSTAT') AS "Solar - EUROSTAT", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Solar' AND source = 'ENTSO-E SOAF') AS "Solar - ENTSO-E SOAF", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Solar' AND source = 'ENTSO-E Data Portal') AS "Solar - ENTSO-E Data Portal", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Solar' AND source = 'ENTSO-E Power Statistics') AS "Solar - ENTSO-E Power Statistics", max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Solar' AND source = 'ENTSO-E Transparency Platform') AS "Solar - ENTSO-E Transparency Platform"
FROM opsd.national_generation_capacity WHERE country = '${country}' GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

panels.title: Wind + solar capacity by country (latest year of the source)
panels.description: Installed wind and solar capacity (MW) of the countries in the selected source, latest year available per country.

targets.rawSql: SELECT country AS "Country", wind AS "Wind", solar AS "Solar" FROM (SELECT country, max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Wind' AND year = y) AS wind, max(capacity) FILTER (WHERE technology = 'Solar' AND year = y) AS solar FROM (SELECT *, max(year) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS y FROM opsd.national_generation_capacity WHERE source = '${source}') s GROUP BY country) x WHERE wind IS NOT NULL OR solar IS NOT NULL ORDER BY coalesce(wind,0)+coalesce(solar,0) DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Capacity table
panels.description: All technologies of the selected country and source in the latest year (MW).

targets.rawSql: SELECT technology AS "Technology", capacity_definition AS "Definition", year AS "Year", capacity AS "Capacity (MW)" FROM opsd.national_generation_capacity WHERE country = '${country}' AND source = '${source}' AND year = (SELECT max(year) FROM opsd.national_generation_capacity WHERE country = '${country}' AND source = '${source}') ORDER BY capacity DESC NULLS LAST
